newsitem.title: USA: Retirees return home after New Jersey fire.
newsitem.headline: Retirees return home after New Jersey fire.

text.p: Nearly 2,000 residents of two retirement complexes returned to their homes Sunday as firefighters contained wind-whipped flames at a scrub forest that had forced their evacuation Saturday.
The flames consumed more than a square mile of the scrub forest on the edge of New Jersey's vast Pine Barrens adjacent to the two retirement communities, Holiday City and Silver Ridge.
Although the flames got close enough to nearly 500 houses to scorch paint, none were seriously damaged, police said.
Fire crews contained the flames along a perimeter and are still fighting hot spots. Dry weather had created a fire hazard, fire officials said.
The evacuees spent the night in community centres in other parts of the sprawling retirement complex, which has a population of 20,000.
